_meta.purpose: go-live checklist §B — the money-facts eval layer for A1b (fresh-price serving). Each case seeds the Tier-2 fact store, runs the shopper's price question through the hydration path, and grades the reply DETERMINISTICALLY (exact price presence/absence + fail-honest), not with a stochastic judge. Run with GCP creds via `pnpm eval:money-facts`; the harness plumbing is gate-tested with a scripted model (money-facts-harness.test.ts). Every case here exercises the CATALOG_RETRIEVAL shell path (retrieval on) — there is no flag-off case in this harness.
_meta.note: The 1h staleness ceiling matches PRODUCT_FACTS_MAX_AGE_MS. ageMinutes > 60 ⇒ stale. S2 (owner-ruled 2026-08-16): the CATALOG_RETRIEVAL render path fetches a brand/policy SHELL, never the live catalog, so ProductFacts is the SOLE price source on this path — a product with no fresh fact (missing, or a fact seeded under a different tenant) renders NO price at all, never the live catalog's base price. This is the more conservative, fail-honest direction for a money/NN#1 fact and STRENGTHENS the invariant vs. pre-S2 (which could show a stale base price the retrieval path no longer even fetches). Operational precondition: priced retrieval serving REQUIRES the A3 ProductFacts producer to have populated a fact for a SKU, or the shopper is told the price needs confirming rather than quoted one at all.
